svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Ragis containers
svg.desc: Web, API, RAG engine, ingestion worker, Postgres, S3, SQS and model providers, and their connections.
svg.text: Same services locally (Docker Compose) and on AWS; only S3/SQS and the identity provider change.
Solid line: service call · dotted: direct browser access with a URL presigned by the API.
